## Goal

Fix gh-79: while a rebase rewinds a unit's `runs/`, norn decides and writes nothing for that unit; the repro loop becomes a passing regression test.

## Progress

- **Fix (H1, S2, S5)**: `rebasing(uf)` (`packages/core/src/decide/receipts.ts`) = `worktree.in_progress.operation === "rebase"`. `decideUnit` (`packages/core/src/decide/story.ts`) checks it first, before the corrupt checks, and emits the distinct noop `unit.rebase_in_progress` ("rebase in progress in <worktree>; runs/ rewound — held until it is concluded"). So nothing is classified, applied, marked corrupt or committed against the rewound files. A merge, cherry-pick or revert does not rewind `runs/`, so BS5.1 stays as it is for those (liveness and deadlines still decided).
- `importMailbox` waits (no import, no reject) while its target unit is rebasing: the cursor is read from the rewound state.json.
- Hardening from the issue's Wanted: the corrupt inbox item's title now carries the validation messages, so "duplicate receipt number 2 (also 0002-classify.json)" names the stray file (`packages/core/src/inbox/items.ts`). The `slices.slice_stuck` detail points a corrupt slice at `norn why`, not at `norn unstick`, which refuses a corrupt unit (`packages/core/src/decide/steps.ts`).
- Tests: the repro is now `packages/cli/test/rebase-rewind.test.ts` (CLI harness, real git; it also asserts the `unit.rebase_in_progress` decision). It joins the suite. Decide tests in `packages/core/test/decide.test.ts` cover the hold, the mailbox wait, the corrupt title and the stuck hint, and each was red without its change. Rule case `unit.rebase_in_progress` is in `rule-cases.ts`. `bun run golden -- --update` changed one case: the corrupt title now carries its message.
- `bun test` 1207/1207, `bun run typecheck` clean. The work was committed by norn in `11e53b8` (alongside the other session's ask).
- Not done: "a receipt norn wrote but never committed can never collide" is covered only by the rebase hold. The store's duplicate-number check is unchanged and still cannot tell a stray file from a committed one, since it has no git.
